name: game.handIn
description: Decides whether a ship parked at the outpost meets a contract, and pays its skill.

spec.title: Hand in a contract
spec.description: Hands in one of the outpost's contracts (game.contracts) with a ship parked within 40 m of the beacon at the moon's north pole; the target is the ship's id. first-flight needs every block of the ship's design placed; beacon-iron takes 1 m³ of iron from its hold; cobalt-shipyard (asteroid ore for the shipyard) takes 2 m³ of ore and unlocks the hauler design; ore-haul takes 12 m³ of ore and needs a hauler. Each pays its skill's experience to the sender (game.player) once. The job board's jobs (V11: pad-rock 3 m³ of rock, ore-run 8 m³ of ore, bulk-ore 30 at Trade 2, station-ore 50 at Trade 3) may be done again and again and alone teach Trade; reaching Trade 3 unlocks the freighter. Refused when the ship does not exist, is not at the outpost, does not meet the contract, or the sender has done it already. V25: refinery-ore (100 m³ of ore, Trade 4) needs an ore barge, which Trade 4 unlocks. V28: jump-trial needs a ship with a jump drive fitted (Ship.jump) and 2 m³ of iron in its hold. V31: cutter-chip takes 4 steel plates and 2 copper wire from the sender's pack (parts) and unlocks the cutter, a chip design.

contract.description: The contract's id: first-flight, beacon-iron, cobalt-shipyard, ore-haul, or a job: pad-rock, ore-run, bulk-ore, station-ore
